violations.message: RiskReport must link at least one evidence id.

input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic post-market surveillance queue reported that the patient lost consciousness and required emergency resuscitation following an unflagged complete atrioventricular block episode, confirmed by hospital emergency response records. The emergency-response record and the device telemetry log disagree on episode onset time by several minutes, an unresolved discrepancy that does not change the outcome.

This constitutes a broad deployed-population exposure risk where automatic containment was absent at the time of harm. According to severity rubric dimension (a), serious harm occurred; dimension (b) is moot as harm realized; dimension (c) shows lack of containment before patient impact.
